Automating Microsoft Entra ID, Intune and Azure Arc safely from code: signing in without a secret in the right cloud, permissions and consent, paging, throttling, batching and delta, then read-only checks for each service mapped to ScubaGear or NIST SP 800-53 Moderate. The foundation the developer workbooks' Graph clients build on.

Work down the page: understand the design, plan it, build it, learn it, watch it, download it, and keep the evidence. [All topics](index.md) lists the others.

## Not here {#gaps}

What the workbook doesn't have on Microsoft automation, and whether it should. [All topics](index.md#gaps) shows the same for every topic.

| Missing | Why |
|---|---|
| Project plan | Not needed, because this is a learning path for the people who build the other topics, not a project. |
| Guide | Not needed, because each module is its own guide, and the services it automates have their guides in the other topics. |
| Developer workbook | Not needed, because the modules carry their own exercises, and Book 19's Chapter 02 is the developer chapter they teach. |
